integrity: The unrestricted proof uses exact divisibility of prime-power divisor sums, multiplicativity and cancellation, a disjoint-divisor lower bound, and Dirichlet/reciprocal-prime theorems for density and infinitude. A finite exact integer replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Only the zero and one fibers are classified; the result does not determine higher fibers or an asymptotic count for the one fiber. The density proof uses classical prime-progression facts.
title: Exact zero and one fibers of the divisor-sum divisibility defect
